heading: Can't be here? *Bring Christmas home.*
lede: Every service on December 23 and 24 streams live on YouTube and the CCC app and remains available for on-demand viewing afterward.
appNote: For TV and mobile, search “Christ Community Church Omaha” in your app store.
checklistNote: A short checklist for watching at home.
checklist: Plan a meal before or after
Invite a few friends or family over
Have a candle ready for the candlelight moment
candleNote: Tap to light. We'll do it together at the end of every service.
